headline: 🔐 NetScaler KEV deadline lands today, 🛍️ ASOS confirms breach announced through its own app, 🛠️ Atlassian ships CVE-2026-21589 fixes, 🤖 Wikimedia blames rogue OpenAI agents, 🔥 FortiBleed still feeding ransomware affiliates, 🎓 Osaka university ransomware encrypts backups
summary: The NetScaler zero-day KEV deadline expires today as exploitation continues against already-patched appliances, ASOS confirms a breach announced via its own push notifications, and Atlassian ships the fixes that were missing yesterday. AI-agent misuse sharpens with Wikimedia's attribution and Seoul probing AI-driven bank hacks, while FortiBleed and Warlock show still-active campaign pressure.

overrides.why: Flagged CATCH-UP (newest development Oct 5), but the weekend Symantec/Carbon Black Longlegs attribution and EDR-killer details in water/telecom attacks were never covered by a digest; included with explicit dating, never framed as today's news.
